title: MLRescurix Operational Budgets Configuration
description: Defines the three configurable operational budgets governing autonomous agent resource consumption. Generous defaults are provided. To change any budget, edit the corresponding 'limit' field.

total_model_tokens.description: Total model token usage counting prompt (input) and completion (output) tokens across all agents and model calls. Default: 5,000,000 tokens.

kaggle_compute.description: Configured target for Kaggle accelerator hours. Not connected to Kaggle dispatch or account quota; not enforced by the autonomous loop.

web_search_queries.description: Configured target for web search requests. A temporary Python bridge records durable admissions for bound clients; unified Rust authority and enforcement across all callers remain unverified. Provider availability is reported separately.

spending_cap_preservation.description: Preserves the existing dollar-denominated model spending cap and ledger history; consult the ledger for the current balance.
